OverviewSection.OverviewParagraph: Discover the glittering Adriatic Sea and its eye-popping coastlines, cruising from Venice to exciting ports of call. Enjoy custom-designed shore excursions in Croatia's Split and Dubrovnik's Riviera and historic Old Town, and striking Kotor in Montenegro. Continue in dazzling western Greece, where you experience unique excursions in Corfu and Cephalonia before transiting through the impressive Corinth Canal and concluding in Athens.

AdvantagesParagraph.AdvantageDescription: Cruise for seven nights on an exclusively chartered, all-inclusive A&K expedition featuring Croatia, Montenegro and the unique islands of Western Greece
Experience the benefits of luxury small-ship expedition featuring no more than 148 guests and rare access to less-frequented ports
Enjoy a choice of included A&K-exclusive excursions in every port spanning a range of activity levels and interests, including nature hikes, cultural discoveries and culinary adventures

ExpertProfile.ExpertBiography: A graduate of the University of Venice and recipient of Princeton University's Stanley J. Seeger Fellowship, Luca is a history scholar and assistant professor at Bilkent University in Turkey. He is working on his third monograph.

Sailing on expedition ships since 1993, Lisa has explored over 100 countries on all seven continents. She also holds an M.A. in international studies and brings a passion for fostering a global mentality.

ItineraryDay.DayDescription: Arrive in Venice, Italy's ever-enchanting floating city with its iconic architecture and gondola-dotted canals. This afternoon, transfer to your luxury expedition small ship and join your fellow guests for a welcome briefing in the evening.

Get to know your Expedition Team this morning with some stimulating talks in the Theater before arriving at your first port. Split is a UNESCO World Heritage Site boasting historic sites seemingly around every corner. Explore its Old Town, including the palace of the Roman emperor Diocletian, which offer some of the very best Roman ruins to be found in the Adriatic, with ancient walkways flanked by columns and passing beneath beautiful arches. Add an optional excursion to nearby Trogir, a charming town with roots stretching back to the third century BC. While in town, stop to see majestic Kamerlengo Castle, built in the 15th century. Alternately, foodies can combine the Split excursion with a market visit and tasting of local favorites along the way. Return to the ship with time to change for your festive Captain's Welcome dinner.

Cruise to Kotor, located in a secluded Dalmatian bay and rich in medieval houses, palaces and churches. Explore these picturesque sites on a guided walk led by local experts and your Expedition Team, viewing beautifully preserved Roman buildings and visiting a 17th-century palace that today houses the Maritime Museum. Its cathedral, built in 1166, showcases the remnants of 13th-century frescoes as well as a Venetian art collection spanning six centuries. For a more comprehensive picture, opt for a full day of exploring, taking in the highlights of Kotor along with a boat excursion to Perast, a finely preserved Baroque city. Alternately, experience the Bay of Kotor on an exhilarating speedboat ride and beach break, with the option to swim the sapphire-like Blue Cave. This natural wonder glows with light reflected from its sandy bottom, and is best appreciated with an optional swim. Another excursion option takes you by boat to Gospa od Skrpjela to visit Our Lady of the Rock Church, built in the Baroque style in 1632 and featuring artworks by local master Tripo Kokolja, including his 33-foot-long Death of the Virgin. Later, return to your luxury ship for cocktails and a briefing on the next day's adventures.

Your luxury ship returns to Croatia for a day in Dubrovnik, rightly lauded as one of the jewels of the Mediterranean. Its medieval buildings and imposing defensive walls rank it among the most iconic cities in Europe, and Game of Thrones fans enjoy the added thrill of recognizing the real-life locations of many King's Landing landmarks. With so much to see and experience, there are a variety of options for spending your day here, starting with a guided walk through the town's medieval monuments, such as the Domican Monastery and Cathedral, the Sponza Palace, the Rector's Palace and Onofriou's Fountain. You can likewise opt for a full-day experience that combines a Dubrovnik tour with a sightseeing expedition into the countryside, complete with a winery visit and fresh lunch at a local farm. Food lovers can enjoy some of the region's most lauded delicacies, including mussels, oysters and olive oil, on a culinary excursion to the village of Orasac and the city of Ston, where you taste fresh shellfish. Meanwhile, active enthusiasts have their choice of a kayaking tour of the Dubrovnik city walls — including a visit to Lokrum Island to swim and explore — or an excursion through the Konavle Valley by bike, following a scenic off-road route through orchards and vineyards, where you stop for a wine tasting.

Even among the beautiful and scenic Greek isles, Corfu stands out for its lush greenery as well as its charmingly winding streets and whitewashed houses. Experience Corfu's most beautiful and renowned landmarks alongside expert local guides and your Expedition Team, visiting the town's prominent sites including the Esplanade, the Town Hall and the Church of Saint Spyridon, patron saint of Corfu. Another option is a visit to the Achilleion Palace, former residence of Kaiser Wilhelm II and one of the most renowned royal villas in Europe, followed by a short walking tour of the town. Corfu is also a wonderful dining destination, highlighted by two excursion options. Delve into an in-depth culinary excursion, during which you visit: a 200-year-old market; a tavern specializing in bourdetto, a casserole-like local dish; a delicatessen where the fresh ice cream is not to be missed; and a shop vending a unique kumquat liqueur. Or opt to roll up your sleeves for a hands-on lesson in cooking Greek dishes at a villa in beautiful Kommeno Bay, afterward enjoying your freshly made lunch with local wine and spectacular views from the villa's terrace. Alternatively, active guests can choose an off-road mountain bike adventure to a secluded village, complete with a stop in a local taverna for a fresh snack.

Like Corfu, Cephalonia is an island known for its green landscapes, with mountains that rise above crystalline blue waters. Immerse yourself in this beautiful island in a variety of ways. Visit the monastery named for St. Gerasimos and see the two-room cave where the medieval monk lived; his remains are kept in a reliquary on site. Joined by your Expedition Team and expert local guide, pair your monastery excursion either with visits to the picturesque villages of Sami and Assos or a trip to the magical underground lake at Melissani, lit with dazzling color when the sun crests overhead. Alternatively, active explorers can set out on a guided sea kayak excursion along the jagged coastline, stopping for a swim at Emplisi Beach. Or for active adventure on land, choose a guided hike across the island, beginning at the village of Fiscardo and taking in a lighthouse, a church and breathtaking beaches.

Itea lies in the arms of the Corinthian Gulf, surrounded by olive groves and the beautiful mountains of Giona and Parnassus. It's also the gateway to mystical Delphi, revered by ancient Greeks as the center of the world. Delphi is also known for its oracles, who dispensed divine wisdom and amassed donations that made the city one of the most prosperous in Greece. Explore its remaining treasures, which include the Sanctuary of Apollo, the Treasury of Athens and the well-preserved stadium. Alternatively, take a scenic drive to the monastery at Ossios Loukas, a Byzantine church with more medieval mosaics and frescoes intact than any other church in Greece. After exploring the church, drive past the quaint village of Arachova before arriving at the village of Delphi for expansive views of the olive-tree-dotted valley. A different kind of hidden gem is the small town of Galaxidi, once a prosperous boat-building town and now site of a museum commemorating the town's naval heritage; stop at the seaside taverna for ouzo and appetizers after exploring on foot. Beekeeping has been practiced on Itea since ancient times, and you have the option to learn about this art with a visit to a family-owned apiary, where you sample its delicious homemade honey. Return to your luxury ship for an afternoon of relaxation and more talks led by your Expedition Team. Today, you also enjoy an unforgettable experience when you transit the Corinth Canal, the bridge joining the Ionian and Aegean seas. Most cargo and cruise ships are too broad to enter this century-old canal, but your narrow-beamed expedition small ship handles it comfortably, cruising past the near-vertical rock walls with plenty of room to spare. Tonight, look forward to your evening recap as well as dinner and conversation on deck under the stars with the new friends you've made.
Bid farewell to your Expedition Team and crew as you disembark in Athens this morning. Continue on your post-tour extension to Thessaloniki or transfer to the airport for your return flight home.

Extension.ExtensionDescription: Discover the Eternal City's most astonishing sights, including ancient ruins, lively piazzas and culinary delights.

ExtensionDay.DayDescription: Arrive in Rome and transfer to your luxury hotel. Join your fellow guests for a Welcome briefing followed by an evening at leisure.
Join your expert guide in discovering Rome, exploring the city's labyrinth of narrow streets and beautiful piazzas, admiring the Pantheon and Trevi Fountain, and visit the imposing Colosseum.
ExtensionDay.HotelAndMealsLine: Baglioni Hotel Regina | Meals: Breakfast, Lunch

ExtensionDay.DayDescription: Discover the stunning Roman Castles area, where you stop at the famous town of Frascati. Visit a vineyard and enjoy a lunch of local specialties with wine. Join your fellow guests for a Roman dinner this evening.
ExtensionDay.HotelAndMealsLine: Baglioni Hotel Regina | Meals: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner

ExtensionDay.DayDescription: After breakfast, transfer to the airport for your flight to Venice, where you begin your main Luxury Expedition Cruise program.

Extension.ExtensionTitle: Treasures of Northern Greece Post-Tour Extension
Extension.ExtensionDescription: Experience the remarkable cuisine, culture and history of Thessaloniki with visits to Meteora, Pella and Vergina.

ExtensionDay.DayDescription: Fly to Thessaloniki. Upon arrival, have lunch and take a panoramic city tour that reveals the iconic White Tower, Galerius' Arch and the Rotunda. Check in to your hotel, where the remainder of your day and dinner are at leisure.
Experience a full-day tour of the UNESCO World Heritage Site of Meteora, where you visit two monasteries. Enjoy lunch in a traditional, beloved restaurant and savor local specialties.

ExtensionDay.DayDescription: Enjoy a visit to fascinating Museum of the Royal Tombs of Aigai in Vergina and discover Pella, birthplace of Alexander the Great.
